process: LignoBoost lignin plant, 50,000 t/yr dry lignin, FRAM2 estimate (pp.55-56)
value: LignoBoost: a black liquor stream from the evaporation plant is acidified with CO2 to precipitate lignin, filtered in a chamber press, re-slurried and re-acidified with H2SO4, then filtered and displacement-washed in a second press; filtrates return to evaporation. Drying, pulverising, pelletising and storage are outside the plant.

process: LignoBoost lignin plant, 50,000 t/yr dry lignin, FRAM2 estimate (pp.55-56)
note: Expected operating cost per tonne of (dry) lignin, mainly chemicals (CO2, H2SO4, NaOH) plus minor extra black liquor evaporation and power; drying, pulverising, pelletising and storage excluded. Low end: mill spent acid covers almost all acid demand and CO2 is recovered from lime kiln flue gas; high end: 100% fresh H2SO4 with NaOH make-up and purchased CO2 (SEK 800/t). Chemical prices at 2007 levels (H2SO4 SEK 400/t, NaOH SEK 2,700/t), so 2007 used as price year. Also printed as SEK 30-80/MWh (other-values). COST BASIS: incremental (operating cost of the lignin plant added to the mill). CAPACITY BASIS: product-output.
